symptom: `create java action M.J (Subject: StringTemplate(Text))` — the form describe prints for a text-template parameter — writes a String parameter; describe of the new action prints `Subject: String`. A describe -> exec of a module's action (BusinessEvents.PublishBusinessEvent_V2) silently turns its template parameter into a String. The generated .java typed it java.lang.String
cause: astDataTypeToJavaActionParamType had no case for ast.TypeStringTemplate and returned its default StringType; sdk/javaactions/source.go mapped StringTemplateParameterType to java.lang.String, pinned by a golden (JA_Tpl) that had itself been measured on an action this bug had created with String parameters
insight: **A golden is only as good as the model it was measured on**: JA_Tpl.java.golden recorded `java.lang.String Q` because mxbuild generated it for the String parameter mxcli had wrongly written. Check a golden's provenance before trusting it as the spec. The real type is `com.mendix.systemwideinterfaces.javaactions.parameters.IStringTemplate`, fully qualified and not imported — seen in the source mxbuild generated for BusinessEvents 3.12's PublishBusinessEvent_V2, and re-measured on 11.13.0: after a `--target=deploy` build mxcli's file is byte-identical to mxbuild's, and a file edited back to java.lang.String is rewritten to IStringTemplate by the build (the control that shows the build regenerates rather than keeps the file). Found while fixing ako/mxcli#1451, whose check-side template validation reads the declared type from the script and would otherwise disagree with exec
